new: At the Council of Chalcedon in 451, the three Palestine provinces were removed from the jurisdiction of the Patriarchate of Antioch. new.author: Adrian Fortescue
new.publisher: The Catholic Encyclopedia, vol. 5 (Robert Appleton Company, New York, 1909), via New Advent
new.note: Arab by birth, educated in an Egyptian monastery, expelled 457, founded a laura near Jericho, ordained priest by Anastasius, succeeded Sallustius as bishop of Jerusalem in 494; resisted Anastasius I's anti-Chalcedonian policy and was banished to Aila (dated 513 here; Wikipedia gives 516).
